usage: deskops closeout commit [-h] [--root ROOT] [--run-dir RUN_DIR |
                               --no-run] [--reason REASON] --task TASK
                               [-m MESSAGE] [--paths [PATHS ...]]
                               [--run-id RUN_ID] [--session SESSION]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --run-dir RUN_DIR     Run evidence dir under runs/subagents/.
  --no-run              Close without a subagent run; requires --reason. Use instead of --run-dir.
  --reason REASON       Why the task closes without a run; required with --no-run.
  --task TASK           Task id being closed.
  -m, --message MESSAGE
                        Commit message subject.
  --paths [PATHS ...]   Paths to stage; defaults to run.yaml touched paths, else staged index.
  --run-id RUN_ID       Subagent run id to record in run.yaml (--run-dir only).
  --session SESSION     Child session.jsonl path to hash into run.yaml (--run-dir only).

Example:
  deskops closeout commit --root . --task task-fix-thing \
    --run-dir runs/subagents/20260729-120000-task-fix-thing \
    --run-id 6046eaef --session ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<dir>/6046eaef/run-0/session.jsonl \
    --paths deskops/foo.py tests/test_foo.py

Without a subagent run, close the task manually and say why:
  deskops closeout commit --root . --task task-fix-thing \
    --no-run --reason "Fixed by the supervisor directly; no subagent was dispatched" \
    --paths deskops/foo.py tests/test_foo.py

With --run-dir the commit message carries Task-Id/Run-Dir/Run-Id/Session-Sha256
trailers; with --no-run it carries Task-Id/Closeout-Mode: manual/Closeout-Reason.
Either way the commit hash is recorded back into runs/subagents/index.jsonl. The
commit is made by this command, not by agent discretion.
